map_contract: --review-map locates a LIST under V. Every copy field is interpreted relative to V, independent of the map file parent. A nested successful-attempt map is compatible only if its copy fields already include the attempt directory relative to V. Otherwise this helper needs a preserved reviewed adaptation with the actual copy base before invocation.
copy_rows: Must provide full original and byte/SHA identity plus declared resolved fields where present, with either a real contained full copy or explicit complete external disposition. Actual source/copy/alias API and review must be read before release.
actual_review_schema: review.json requires spec_verdict, quality_verdict, open_findings and scope; freeze files can be exact path/bytes/sha256 LIST or DICT.
actual_capture_schema: proof.json status PASS_LITERAL_ACTUAL_SCOPE_CAPTURE_PENDING_ROOT_RELEASE, scope pin, root_count, file_descriptors and individual_files must match actual literal scope.
scope_contract: Six controls and exact required_completed_roots equal the pinned initial scope; unique actual complete roots, all full original descriptors and truthful later_external_after_snapshot. Actual scope review must establish complete helper/caller/history coverage.
execution_location: Run only the reviewed source at its integration path; preserved review copies have a different __file__ parent.
runtime_environment: Nonoptimized Python with bytecode disabled, as inherited from the canonical caller contract.
